seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sār'atthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm'eva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ atikkamma papaṭikaṃ, sākhāpalāsaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkameyya sāran'ti maññamāno.

62484.meaning1: surrounded by heartwood; (comm) encircled by hardwood trees

examples.text: katame cattāro? pheggu phegguparivāro, pheggu sāraparivāro, sāro phegguparivāro, sāro sāraparivāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhā. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.

62485.meaning1: reached the heart; attained the essence
62485.commentary: (DNa) ito parañ'ca aggabhāvaṃ vā sārabhāvaṃ vā ajānanto aggappattā sārappattā cā'ti āha.

examples.text: addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā cā'ti. na kho, nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca, api ca kho papaṭikappattā hotī'ti.

62487.meaning1: who perceive essence; believing there is substance; thinking there is permanence (in)
62487.commentary: (DHPa) tattha asāre sāramatino'ti cattāro paccayā, dasavatthukā micchādiṭṭhi, tassā upanissayabhūtā dhammadesanā'ti ayaṃ asāro nāma, tasmiṃ sāradiṭṭhino'ti attho.

examples.text: asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.

62488.meaning1: made of hardwood; (comm) made of red sandalwood heartwood

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītipallaṅkasahassāni ahesuṃ dantamayāni sāramayāni sovaṇṇamayāni goṇak'atthatāni paṭik'atthatāni paṭalik'atthatāni kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇāni sauttaracchadāni ubhatolohitak'ūpadhānāni.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pallaṅkasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so pallaṅko hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena paribhuñjāmi, dantamayo vā sāramayo vā sovaṇṇamayo vā rūpiyamayo vā.
sace n'eresi attānaṃ, kaṃso upahato yathā, esa patto'si nibbānaṃ, sārambho te na vijjati.
thambhassa ca pahānāya sārambhassa ca pahānāya, atthi majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.

62492.meaning1: quarrelsome speech; angry discussion; fighting talk
62492.commentary: (DHPa) sārambhakathā'ti esā karaṇ'uttarā yugaggāhakathā nāma dukkhā. (UDa) diṭṭhīsu sārambhakathā, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattatī'ti idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti attukkaṃsanaparavambhanavasena attano diṭṭh'ābhinivesena paresaṃ diṭṭhīsu sārambhakathā virodhakathā saṃsāranāyikānaṃ avijjātaṇhānaṃ appahānato saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati, na atikkamatī'ti attho.

examples.text: m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.

62493.meaning1: born from violence; produced by aggression

examples.text: sārambhaṃ vineyya viharāhi. sārambhaṃ vineyya viharanto na sārambhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā'ti.
na paccanīkasātena, suvijānaṃ subhāsitaṃ, upakkiliṭṭhacittena, sārambhabahulena ca.

62497.commentary: (SNa) sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase'ti satimantaṃ paṇḍitaṃ taṃ mayam'pi sārayāma, sataṃ vā dhammaṃ mayaṃ taṃ sārayāmā'ti attho.

examples.text: aratiṃ pajahāsi sato, bhavāsi sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase, pātālarajo hi duttaro, mā taṃ kāmarajo avāhari.
dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu'paramaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ
